This directory contains the normalization-only header subset of
[uni-algo](https://github.com/uni-algo/uni-algo) at commit
`6c091fa266ac03a852128429af3b7481cf50a0ab`.

It is vendored only for portable Unicode NFC normalization. The BlackFlow
matcher does not call compatibility normalization, character properties, case
mapping, or segmentation. The upstream project is available under either the
Public Domain or MIT license; see `LICENSE.md`.
